data.name: ToolDescription_tabs_list
data.value: Lists all open tabs with IDs, titles and active state.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_run
data.value: Starts workspace execution. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_stop
data.value: Stops workspace execution. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_wait_seconds
data.value: Waits for a specified number of seconds before the next tool step.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_model
data.value: Returns the complete workspace model. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_validate
data.value: Returns compact workspace validation. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_io
data.value: Reads visible text/number I/O values. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_settings
data.value: Returns visible component settings. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_bounds
data.value: Returns positions, visible width/height, stored sizes, size source and minimum/maximum dimensions in canvas units. Stored zero dimensions mean automatic sizing. Optional tabId; defaults to the request-pinned workspace.

data.name: ToolDescription_app_log_recent
data.value: Returns recent in-memory application log entries.

data.name: ToolDescription_comp_list
data.value: Lists components by category. Categories: CiphersClassic, CiphersModernSymmetric, CiphersModernAsymmetric, Steganography, HashFunctions, CryptanalysisSpecific, CryptanalysisGeneric, Protocols, ToolsBoolean, ToolsDataflow, ToolsDataInputOutput, ToolsRandomNumbers, ToolsCodes, ToolsMisc, Undefined.

data.name: ToolDescription_comp_list_by_category
data.value: Lists components for one category only. Allowed categories: CiphersClassic, CiphersModernSymmetric, CiphersModernAsymmetric, Steganography, HashFunctions, CryptanalysisSpecific, CryptanalysisGeneric, Protocols, ToolsBoolean, ToolsDataflow, ToolsDataInputOutput, ToolsRandomNumbers, ToolsCodes, ToolsMisc, Undefined.

data.name: ToolDescription_comp_fullnames
data.value: Lists technical full type names of all available components.

data.name: ToolDescription_comp_docs
data.value: Returns generated online help/documentation for a component type.

data.name: ToolDescription_comp_defaults
data.value: Returns default TaskPane settings for a component type.

data.name: ToolDescription_tpl_list
data.value: Lists available templates in compact form with templatePath and title.

data.name: ToolDescription_tpl_info
data.value: Returns detailed metadata for one template, including summary, description and keywords.

data.name: ToolDescription_tpl_open
data.value: Opens an existing template in a new visible workspace tab and returns at least the new tabId.

data.name: ToolDescription_tpl_model
data.value: Loads a template and returns its workspace model abstraction.

data.name: ToolDescription_tpl_io
data.value: Reads text/number I/O values from a template workspace.

data.name: ToolDescription_tpl_bounds
data.value: Returns positions and sizes of elements in a template workspace.

data.name: ToolDescription_tpl_settings
data.value: Returns visible component settings from a template workspace.

data.name: ToolDescription_text_ui
data.value: Returns UI/help text by topic: startcenter, wizard, workspace, crypcloud, store, homomorphic, prf_kdf.

data.name: ToolDescription_open_documentation_text
data.value: Returns the plain text of the currently active Online Help/documentation tab. Optional tabId: if omitted, the active tab is used.

data.name: ToolDescription_tutorial_docs_all
data.value: Returns the full assembled documentation text for one crypto tutorial. Allowed tutorialName values: Attacks on PKCS#1, Lattice-based Cryptography, World of Primes.

data.name: ToolDescription_tutorial_docs_summary
data.value: Returns a reduced plain-text summary of the documentation for one crypto tutorial. Allowed tutorialName values: Attacks on PKCS#1, Lattice-based Cryptography, World of Primes.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_add_component
data.value: Adds a component at optional position. Optional name sets the visible short user-facing label/description text. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_new
data.value: Creates a new visible tab with an empty workspace and returns at least the new tabId.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_add_connection
data.value: Creates a connection between connectors. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_set_component_text
data.value: Sets a text/number value by component ID. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_set_component_name
data.value: Sets the visible short user-facing label/description text of a component by component ID. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_move_component
data.value: Moves a component to absolute x/y position. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_remove_component
data.value: Removes a component by component ID. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_remove_connection
data.value: Removes a connection between connectors. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_set_component_setting
data.value: Sets one visible component setting by component ID and property name. Value is converted to the target setting type. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_add_memo
data.value: Adds a memo field with optional initial text and optional x/y position. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_set_memo_text
data.value: Sets the plain text of a memo field by memoId. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_move_memo
data.value: Moves a memo field to absolute x/y position. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_remove_memo
data.value: Removes a memo field by memoId. Optional tabId; active workspace is used if omitted.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_screenshot
data.value: Captures an actual PNG image of the visible workspace viewport without changing its zoom or scroll position. Requires a vision-capable model. Optional tabId; defaults to the request-pinned workspace.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_resize_component
data.value: Changes an existing component's width and height in canvas units without replacing it. Expands icon mode when a resizable view exists, respects minimum/maximum sizes and supports Undo/Redo. Preserves text, position and connections. Optional tabId.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_resize_memo
data.value: Changes a memo text box's width and height in canvas units, preserving its text and position. Respects minimum/maximum sizes and supports Undo/Redo. Optional tabId.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_set_connector_orientation
data.value: Moves an existing connector to the top (North), bottom (South), right (East), or left (West) side of its component. Preserves its input/output direction and connections, reroutes attached wires, and supports Undo/Redo. Uses the technical connector name from the workspace model.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_redraw_connection
data.value: Recalculates the route of exactly one existing wire using its connection ID from the workspace model. Preserves the connection, both endpoints, components and data flow. Verify the resulting route with the layout check and workspace screenshot.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_check_layout
data.value: Checks occupied box overlaps, spacing, memo clipping and wire routes. Wires passing through any box, including their source or target, are errors. Reports affected IDs and advice to move receivers or change connector sides; shared outputs require checking all branches.

data.name: ToolDescription_ws_fit_memo
data.value: Fits a memo to its formatted content at the selected width, preserving content and focus with Undo/Redo.

data.name: ToolDescription_tpl_search
data.value: Searches template metadata by task keywords. Suitable templates should be suggested with a reason; opening or building waits for the user's choice.
